{{Top|leg}}
A '''foil''' was a type of [[rapier]], and was commonly constructed from [[flexisteel]]. Foils were often used in [[fencing]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> Examples included the [[Swiftcut foil]] and the [["Twenchok" foil]].

[[Ketrian Altronel]] used a foil to scar [[Stevan Makintay]]'s face when he intervened in a duel between her and a rival for his affections.<ref name="Firepower">{{JournalCite|8|Firepower}}</ref>
